title: OrbCannonMod
description: A Lightweight "Orbital Strike Cannon" Mod! (for paper 1.21.11+!) hope you like it<3
body:
**
```
Orbital Strike Cannon
```
**

Adds powerful orbital strike mechanics to your Minecraft server with this lightweight plugin, inspired by popular content creators such as Wemmbu and Flamefrags.
The plugin introduces four distinct destruction weapons that allow players or administrators to call down devastating TNT-based strikes from orbit. Perfect for anarchy servers, faction warfare, large-scale events, minigames, or chaotic multiplayer sessions.
Key Features

Nuke Shot — Wide-area explosive payload for maximum destruction
Stab Shot — Precision vertical strike that drills deep into the terrain.
